Users send a voice note describing what they want to do, and Jay transcribes, analyzes, and automatically executes the corresponding actions in connected systems. pourquoiNextjs.question: Why choose Next.js over React alone?
pourquoiNextjs.answer: Next.js adds server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and automatic optimizations to React. Result: faster sites that rank better on Google.

nextjsSeo.question: Is a Next.js site better for SEO?
nextjsSeo.answer: Yes, significantly. Unlike client-side React, Next.js generates complete HTML that Google can index immediately, improving your natural search ranking.

wordpressVsNextjs.question: What's the difference between a WordPress and Next.js site?
wordpressVsNextjs.answer: WordPress is ideal for content sites that need easy editing. Next.js offers superior performance and total flexibility for custom projects or web applications.

nextjsPME.question: Is Next.js suitable for small businesses?
nextjsPME.answer: Absolutely. Next.js allows creating ultra-fast showcase sites at controlled costs. Hosting is often free (Vercel) and performance is excellent.

prixReact.question: How much does a React/Next.js site cost?
prixReact.answer: My prices don't depend on the technology: business website from €1,190 excl. VAT, custom application from €3,900. React and Next.js simply let me deliver a faster site sooner: you pay for the result, not the stack. Instant estimate in 3 minutes via the online brief.

tarifs.compareTitle: How does it compare to other options?
tarifs.compareIntro: Let's be honest: I'm not the right option for everyone. Here are the three ways to get a website in 2026.

diy.title: Do it yourself (Wix, AI...)
diy.text: AI builders make decent sites in a few hours. You pay a lifelong subscription, the design stays template-like, and local SEO against equipped competitors is hard.
diy.forWhom: To test an idea or start with no budget.

lowcost.title: Low-cost freelancer
lowcost.text: Often a quickly-dressed WordPress theme. It can be enough, but quality varies: performance, security and long-term support are rarely there.
lowcost.forWhom: For a one-off need, if you can judge quality.

jbr.title: Custom-built, with me
jbr.text: A site designed for your business, cleanly built (no theme), serious local SEO, and a single contact in Lille accountable for the result, replying within 24 hours.
jbr.forWhom: For a website that must actually bring in clients.

quote.text: The development of our new website has just been completed and JB delivered work that exceeded our expectations. His understanding of the issues, his responsiveness, and his way of translating our requests was simply perfect.
quote.author: Thierry Dehon
quote.role: CEO of RDP Glass, verified Google review

why-from.question: Can the final price exceed the displayed price?
why-from.answer: The "from" price covers a standard project. After our first conversation, the quote sets a precise amount based on your scope — and that amount is final: no surprises along the way.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: 50% when signing the quote to start the work, 50% at go-live. Maintenance is billed monthly with no long-term commitment.

what-raises.question: What makes a quote go up?
what-raises.answer: Mainly: the number of pages or features, content creation (copy, photos, translations), migrating an existing site, and integrations with your tools. I always show the impact of each option on the quote.

hidden-costs.question: Are there hidden recurring costs?
hidden-costs.answer: No. A website has two unavoidable recurring costs: the domain name and hosting. Either you manage them yourself (I show you how), or the €79/month maintenance includes them along with updates and improvements.
